fusions.name: Seize and Thrash
fusions.desc: You grab the target and strike it with your weapon for 12 damage, leaving it [Stunned] for 1 second and [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Raw Knuckles
fusions.desc: Pounds both fists down at the cost of 5% of your maximum health, dealing 8 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Its damage rises 7% for every 10% of your health already gone, up to 35%.

fusions.name: Sandpaper Clinch
fusions.desc: For 10 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. Each kill you make while it is active restores 5 health.

fusions.name: Pounding Tempo
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you deal 3% more damage per stack (18% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
